newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki easier amid flood of interim reports.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki easier amid flood of interim reports.

text.p: Shares sagged in thin trade on Wednesday, failing to draw strength from a record overnight Wall Street close and a flood of domestic corporate results.

Commenting on the results, one broker said: "Neste's, Metra's and Kesko's four-month results were disappointing." But brokers said bargain-hunters could appear and provide some support at lower levels.
Kesko fell 2.00 markka to 75.50 in moderate volume after reporting January-April profits below analysts' expectations.
Neste lost 4.50 markka to 133.00 in scant volume after reporting four-month profits below expectations.

Metra fell 1.50 markka to 146.00 in fair seven million markka volume after it reported first tertial profits down to 38 million markka from 50 million a year ago. The result was near the bottom end of the range of analysts' forecasts in a Reuters poll.
Orion bucked the weak trend among the reporting companies, gaining 3.00 markka to 208.00 after touching 209.00 in thin dealings.
While still digesting the interim reports, brokers said they expected a quiet day with summertime laziness setting in.
